inputs.original_text: French abbot Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), has been convicted under France’s controversial new law targeting “psychological subjection.” The case has raised concern among religious communities and civil liberties advocates across France.
inputs.modified_text: They’ve convicted Father Bernard Domini under France’s new “psychological subjection” law—a vague tool that can be turned against religious communities whenever they become inconvenient. The alarm from civil-liberties advocates is no surprise: this looks less like neutral law enforcement and more like institutions testing how far they can stretch the rules to silence dissent.
